description: Render a Markdown file to HTML and convert it to PDF with Playwright/Chromium. Raw HTML in the Markdown is filtered (no scripts, frames or event handlers) unless the user's settings file says otherwise; removed_html in the result lists what was taken out. ```mermaid blocks are drawn as diagrams; diagram_errors lists any that could not be drawn and were left as code.

accent_color.description: Accent colour of the page style, as #rgb or #rrggbb: title rules, coloured titles, code block bars. Used by the report and technical looks; the others have no accent.

breaks.description: Enable hard line breaks in the Markdown renderer.

display_header_footer.description: Display header and footer on each page. Content comes from `header` / `footer` (here, in settings or in front matter); without them the header and footer are empty. Enabled automatically when `header` or `footer` is given.

font_family.description: CSS font-family value for the document body and header/footer. Overrides the default system font stack. Example: "Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif".

footer.description: Structured page footer as JSON, same shape as `header`. Example for page numbers: {"center_text":"Page {page} of {pages}"}. Replaces the footer from settings; front matter still overrides it.

header.description: Structured page header as JSON. Shorthand keys: left_text, center_text, right_text, left_image, height. Placeholders: {title}, {date}, {page}, {pages}, {filename}, {author}. Example: {"center_text":"{title}","right_text":"{date}"}. Replaces the header from settings; front matter still overrides it.

heading_anchors.description: Give each heading an id so [text](#heading) links and the table of contents work. On by default.

heading_font_family.description: CSS font-family value for headings (h1-h6). Default: same as the body text.

highlight.description: Enable syntax highlighting for code blocks.

include_default_styles.description: Include the built-in default CSS stylesheet.

input_path.description: Markdown file to export. Use an absolute path.

margin.description: Optional per-call page margins. Any omitted side falls back to settings/defaults.

math.description: Render LaTeX math via KaTeX. Use $inline$ and $$display$$ syntax.

error_color.description: CSS color used for inline error messages.

throw_on_error.description: If true, abort rendering on a LaTeX error. Default false (renders error inline).

mermaid.description: Draw ```mermaid code blocks as diagrams. A diagram that fails to parse stays a code block and is listed in diagram_errors. On by default.

page_ranges.description: Paper ranges to print, e.g. '1-5, 8, 11-13'. Empty means all pages.

print_background.description: Whether to print background colours and images.

stylesheet_path.description: Optional CSS file applied after the built-in stylesheet.

toc.description: Render a [[toc]] marker as an auto-generated table of contents (also enables heading anchors).

name: export_markdown_pdf
title: Export Markdown PDF
